verdict.rationale: Gating inbound messages is a fair question for a self-hosted AI assistant platform, but the evidence never describes sender allowlists, DM policies, or mention gating for messaging channels. The fine-grained admin controls, multi-user permissions, and API keys apply to the app's own users and API access. Embedded chat widgets are a separate surface, and none of this shows gating of inbound messages, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a self-hoster, inbound messages are gated — sender allowlists, DM policies, mention gating — so only people I approve can drive my assistant
